review:
I am the world record holder for Fork Parker's Holiday Profit Hike.
I challenge all who read this message to dare oppose me.

Balls hard indie platformer.
It made me swear a lot especially towards the end and i felt like quitting more than once but i wouldn't be beaten!!!
I died 104 times and it look me 69 minutes to finish. Huh huh huh 69....
For some reason it wouldn't recognise my PS4 controller even though the game has PS4 button prompts so i had to use my crappy 3rd party Xbox 360 controller and it's clicky clacky D-pad.

There are speedruns online where psychopaths have finished it in less than 8 minutes.
It's free, give it a try if you like having high blood pressure.

Not too bad of a platformer, since it's free I doubt there will be an update but definitely needs some tighter controls. Inputs get eaten whether using a keyboard or xbox controller but not often enough to not enjoy the game.  

Also the wall jump is absolutely worthless in this game except getting you killed when you are on a rope next to a wall.
